label: Trustpilot
terms_note: Invitations may only follow a real purchase or service and must go to all customers or a fair sample (no cherry-picking, no incentives); replies must come from the business and are public.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (review replies + invitations, behind the paid API module).
auth: 1. Trustpilot for Business account with the **API module** → API key + secret in the Business app (Integrations).
2. Public endpoints: `apikey` header / query. Private endpoints: **Business user OAuth token** —

endpoints.call: POST https://invitations-api.trustpilot.com/v1/private/business-units/{businessUnitId}/email-invitations` {consumerEmail, consumerName, referenceNumber, templateId, redirectUri, preferredSendTime}
endpoints.purpose: after a real purchase / service only

endpoints.call: Business app → webhook on new review / reply

reference.limits: - Rate-limiting best-practices page (limits per API key; exact numbers not rendered today); 429 → back off. - Trustpilot Guidelines: invite all customers or a fair sample (no cherry-picking), replies must come from the business, no incentives; API module is a paid add-on.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Trustpilot API key (Client ID); HTTP Basic username on the refresh request ('Authorization: Basic [BASE64_ENCODED(API_KEY:API_SECRET)]', https://developers.trustpilot.com/authentication).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Trustpilot API secret; HTTP Basic password on the refresh request.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Business-user refresh token from the authorization-code or password grant. 'Access tokens expire after 100 hours and refresh tokens expire after 30 days'; the runtime mints access tokens from it and keeps a returned new refresh token (PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR persists it).

config_fields.name: business_unit_id
config_fields.help: Business unit id (GET /v1/business-units/find?name=<domain> with the API key).

config_fields.name: business_user_id
config_fields.help: Id of the business user replies are authored by (authorBusinessUserId).

me.note: No who-am-I endpoint: fetches one private review of config business_unit_id, which verifies the business-user token and the unit (account.reviews[0].businessUnit).

read_mentions.note: The business unit's REVIEWS as mentions (private endpoint, newest first; stars, title, companyReply, consumer email in raw). Limited to 100,000 records; `since` is not sent.

reply_comment.note: Posts the company reply to review `comment_id` (id from read_mentions), authored by config business_user_id. A review has a single reply and the response body is not documented, so `id` is a fixed marker.

not_offered.publish_text: Businesses cannot publish posts; the Service Reviews API only replies to, tags and reads reviews (https://developers.trustpilot.com/service-reviews-api/).
not_offered.read_comments: Reviews have no comment threads, only a single companyReply (https://developers.trustpilot.com/service-reviews-api/); reviews are exposed as read_mentions.
not_offered.delete: A business cannot delete reviews; only its own reply can be deleted (DELETE /v1/private/reviews/{reviewId}/reply, https://developers.trustpilot.com/service-reviews-api/), which is not a post.
not_offered.analytics_post: No per-review metrics endpoint beyond likes (https://developers.trustpilot.com/service-reviews-api/).

evidence: host api.trustpilot.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 403 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 3/3 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
